_comment: QuantZhai search config template. Copy to config/user/search.json and fill in your SearXNG base URL. Never commit config/user/search.json.

searxng._base_url_comment: Use http://127.0.0.1:8890 for the Agent API (retrieval metadata); use http://127.0.0.1:8888 for raw SearXNG.

_profiles_comment: Override profile definitions here. Omit to inherit from config/default/search.json.
_routing_comment: Override per-turn limits here. Omit individual fields to use defaults.

routing._budget_mode_comment: default_budget_mode: limits used when the model omits budget_mode. Choices: quick, normal (default), deep, audit. quick=single fact check, normal=routine work, deep=research, audit=exhaustive scan.
routing._budget_modes_comment: Named mode table. Each mode sets all five budget fields. Omit the entire budget_modes key to use built-in defaults. Operator-tunable: raise or lower any field. Values are clamped by absolute_max_* below.
routing._absolute_caps_comment: Operator safety rails. Clamp all mode values regardless of budget_mode. Lower to restrict. Cannot raise above the built-in code constants (100/100/100/50/120000).
routing._flat_comment: Flat fields below are the #60 compatibility layer. Used only when budget_modes key is absent entirely.

_disabled_comment: Add engine names to disable them for your instance.

compatibility._comment: Set legacy_policy_path to use an existing search-policy.json for web_search_profiles routing.
